plan.title: Gender Improvement Comparison
plan.subtitle: Comparison of physical improvements between girls and boys in baseline and endline data

panels.title: Avg shuttle run improvement (girls)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(endline."Shuttle run sec" - baseline."Shuttle run sec") AS improvement FROM baseline JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID" WHERE baseline."Gender" = 'Female'

panels.title: Avg shuttle run improvement (boys)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(endline."Shuttle run sec" - baseline."Shuttle run sec") AS improvement FROM baseline JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID" WHERE baseline."Gender" = 'Male'

panels.title: Shuttle run time by gender
panels.sql: SELECT 'Baseline' AS period, "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_time FROM baseline GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'Endline' AS period, "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_time FROM endline GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Sit ups by gender
panels.sql: SELECT 'Baseline' AS period, "Gender", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_situps FROM baseline GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'Endline' AS period, "Gender", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_situps FROM endline GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Top 10 shuttle run improvements
panels.sql: SELECT baseline."Child ID", baseline."Gender", endline."Shuttle run sec" - baseline."Shuttle run sec" AS improvement FROM baseline JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID" WHERE endline."Shuttle run sec" < baseline."Shuttle run sec" ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 10
